# Job `pr`: `pr open`, `pr poll`, `pr rebase`

Tier S2 · Needs: `ledger-core`, `git-wt`, `queue-ask` · Read `_common.md` first. Contract sections: §11 (`pr open|poll|rebase`), §13. Trial evidence: `docs/research/raw/w4-review-git-worktree.md` (odysseus `gh` queries, wyattjoh `gh pr checks --json bucket`), `docs/trials/t3-worktrees-merge.md` (F10, Recipes "pr rebase").

## Goal
Open the Workflow's single PR, turn new CI failures and review comments into Lead messages, detect the merge, and rebase the Lead Branch cleanly when asked.

## Files you own
`src/pr/gh.ts`, `src/pr/state.ts`, `src/pr/open.ts`, `src/pr/poll.ts`, `src/commands/{pr-open,pr-poll,pr-rebase}.ts`, `test/pr/**`, `test/commands/pr-*.test.ts`.

## Requirements
- `gh.ts`: `gh` runner with zod-parsed JSON. Queries, exactly as named in §11:
  - `gh pr create --base --head --title --body` (parse the URL and number from output; use `--json` where supported);
  - `gh pr view <n> --json state,mergedAt,statusCheckRollup,reviews,comments`;
  - `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}/comments`.

  The owner and repo come from `gh repo view --json nameWithOwner` in the repo.
- `open.ts` (`cpd pr open`):
  - preconditions per §11;
  - `git push -u origin cpd/<wf>` from the Lead worktree;
  - body = Workflow title + Jobs table (key, title, status, merged SHA) + "Generated by cpd";
  - phase `dispatch → pr` (via the `ledger-core` phase function); record `workflow.json.pr`.
- `poll.ts` (`cpd pr poll`): §11 and §13.
  - Diff against `pr-state.json`. On changes, send one `pr-feedback` (`notifyLead`) carrying the check names and conclusions, review ids and states, comment ids, authors, paths, lines and bodies (truncate bodies at 2,000 chars).
  - On merge: phase `pr → done`, `MIGRATION-FREEZE` in the Ledger dir, `workflow-done`.
  - Idempotent: a second poll with no change sends nothing.
- `pr-rebase` command: the `rebaseLeadOntoBase` from `git-wt`, then `git push --force-with-lease`; conflict → `rebase_conflict` (exit 3) with files.

## Acceptance
All tests use a fake `gh` (`test/helpers/fakeBin`) and a local bare git repo as `origin`. No network, no real GitHub.
1. `pr open` refuses when any Job is not closed or cancelled. Otherwise it pushes (the branch exists in the bare origin), calls `gh pr create` with the exact argv, and records the PR.
2. `pr poll` sequence with canned `gh` outputs:
   - first poll with no feedback: no message;
   - a failing check plus 2 review comments: one `pr-feedback` with exactly those;
   - the same state again: no message;
   - merged: `workflow-done`, phase `done`, freeze marker present.
3. `pr rebase` clean and conflict cases against fixture repos (the conflict leaves the Lead worktree unchanged).

## Out of scope
Creating Jobs from feedback (the Lead does that); scheduling the poll (Job `watch`).
